changelog.name: v1.0.2
changelog.body:
# 修复

- 修复模块设置中推荐流过滤器关键字过滤修改配置行为异常的问题。
- 修复模块更新检查事实上失效的问题。

---

# Fixes

- Fx the issue where modifying keyword filter settings for the recommended feed filter in module
  config behaves abnormally.
- Fix the issue where module update check was effectively not working.

changelog.name: v1.0.1
changelog.body:
# 新功能

- 位于宿主端的模块设置页已被废弃，模块设置页已迁移至模块端。从此版本开始， 位于宿主端的模块设置入口将直接唤起模块本体。

# 破坏性变更

- 模块配置备份格式变更，为保证平稳过渡，此版本将继续兼容导入从之前 版本导出的配置备份文件。

- 原先保存于宿主端的模块配置信息已被废弃，模块将不再使用它们，新的模块 配置信息由底层 Xposed
  框架托管。由于宿主对新的模块配置仅有读权限， 故更新该版本后，用户需要手动将配置备份文件通过位于模块本体的导入
  功能导入。若你之前没有保存备份文件，请通过长按宿主内的模块入口， 唤起临时配置迁移页面以导出模块配置。

# 依赖

- 更新项目依赖

# 温馨提示

- 新版本的模块配置存储完全依赖于 libxposed 提供的 RemotePreference。 使用免 Root 框架可能导致模块在
  Hook 早期初始化配置存储时崩溃，或静默回报默认值（默认值为功能关闭状态）。但模块目前暂未彻底移除旧版
  设置页与旧版配置读写接口，若你有需要，请携带模块日志向作者反馈， 这将影响本模块未来是否提供配置存储方案的切换功能。

---

# New Features

- The module settings page hosted inside the target app has been deprecated. Settings have been
  moved into the module itself. Starting from this release, the old settings entry inside the host
  app will launch the module directly.

# Breaking Changes

- Module backup format has changed. For smooth migration, this version still supports importing
  backups exported by older releases.

- Legacy module configurations stored inside the host app are deprecated and will no longer be read.
  New configurations are managed by the underlying Xposed framework. Since the host app only has
  read access to the new configuration storage, after upgrading to this version you must manually
  import your backup using the import feature inside the module. If you do not have a backup file,
  long‑press the old module entry in the host app to open the temporary migration page and export
  your old configurations.

# Dependencies

- Update project dependencies

# Notes

- The new configuration storage relies entirely on RemotePreference provided by libxposed. When
  using rootless hook frameworks, the module may crash during early‑stage storage initialization, or
  silently fall back to default values (all features disabled by default). The legacy settings page
  and old configuration I/O APIs are not yet fully removed. If you require the old storage behavior,
  please submit a report with module logs. This feedback will help decide whether a storage‑backend
  switch will be added in the future.

changelog.name: v0.16.2
changelog.body:
# 修复

- 修复在某些安卓版本上动态表情保存为 GIF 失败或画面撕裂的问题。

---

# Fixes

- Fix the issue where, on certain Android versions, saving animated emoji as GIF fails or causes
  frame tearing.

changelog.name: v0.16.1
changelog.body:
# 修复

- 修复“阻止弹幕隐藏”启用时，进入清屏模式会出现部分组件意外恢复可见性的问题。
- 修复“阻止自动重播”启用时，宿主首页冷启动控件未加载、热启动回到前台视频渲染区域无画面的问题。
- 支持在导航项“商城”和“朋友”位置互换场景下的隐藏。

---

# Fixes

- Fixed an issue where, with "Keep Danmaku Visible" enabled, entering clean mode could unexpectedly
  restore visibility of some components.
- Fixed an issue where, with "Block Resume Playback" enabled, the host homepage failed to load
  controls on cold start, and returning to foreground on hot start left the video render area blank.
- Added support for hiding the "Mall" and "Friends" tab items when their positions are swapped.

changelog.name: v0.16.0
changelog.body:
# 新功能

- 允许隐藏播放页头像下方的关注按钮

---

# New Features

- Allow hiding follow button below avatar on playback

changelog.name: v0.15.1
changelog.body:
# 修复

- 修复推荐流过滤器中“隐藏已关注作者的内容”开启时，部分情况下会导致所有内容被无条件过滤的问题。
- 修复“净化播放页”总开关逻辑反转的问题。
- 尝试修复在部分机器上模块验证闪退的问题，同时允许在特定条件下跳过模块验证。

---

# Fixes

- Fixed an issue where enabling "Hide content from followed creators" in Recommended Feed Filter
  could unconditionally filter all content under certain conditions.
- Fixed inverted main-switch logic in Playback Purifier.
- Attempted to fix module verification crash on some devices; allow module verification to be
  skipped when the app language is non-Chinese.

changelog.name: v0.15.0
changelog.body:

---

# New Features

- Allow selectively removing some navigation items from the top bar
- A new filter has been added to hide content from followed creators

changelog.name: v0.14.0

---

- Allow selectively removing some navigation items from the bottom bar

# Improvements

- Redraw main module UI. Redraw for host-side dialogs awaits upstream support for LibXposed API 102

changelog.name: v0.13.1
changelog.body:
# 新功能

- 允许自定义混淆映射表，使用方法请参阅[文档](https://github.com/twyora/DouyinEnhancer/blob/main/docs/zh-cn/guide/custom-obfuscation-mapping.md)。
- 支持重置混淆映射表以迫使模块重新搜索方法。
- 模块应用内新增「帮助」入口。

---

# New Features

- Allow custom obfuscation mapping. See [documentation](https://github.com/twyora/DouyinEnhancer/blob/main/docs/en/guide/custom-obfuscation-mapping.md) for usage instructions.
- Add support for resetting obfuscation mapping to force the module to re-search methods.
- Add a new "Help" entry inside the module app.

readme:
# DouyinEnhancer

[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/github/license/twyora/DouyinEnhancer)](https://github.com/twyora/DouyinEnhancer/blob/main/LICENSE)
![GitHub tag (latest by date)](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/twyora/DouyinEnhancer)

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README_zh_CN.md)

A small Xposed module that adds quality-of-life features to Douyin

> This project is still in its early stages. Features are being added gradually — feedback and
> suggestions are welcome

## Tested Environment

> Douyin v37.6.0 (last tested on module v0.6.0)
>
> Douyin v38.8.0
>
> Douyin v40.3.0 (Not tested by maintainer)
---
> Other versions are untested with no guaranteed functionality. Please report issues or submit PRs
> for any
> problems

## Features

- Download comment images without watermark
- Save comment emojis to album
- ~~Video filtering~~ Recommended feed filtering
- Save playing content to album
- Save audio comments from comment section
- Bypass Listen Aweme mode copyright restrictions
- Disable double-tap to like in feed
- Open comment panel by double-tap in feed
- Keep danmaku visible when entering clean mode
- Automatically pause video on playback completion
- Block auto video resumption on foreground return
- Block specific playback‑page components
- Selectively removing some navigation items from the top or bottom bar
- Hiding follow button below avatar on playback

---
See more about future development: [PM.md](PM.md)

## Usage

1. Activate the module in your Xposed manager (e.g. LSPosed)
2. Set the scope to Douyin (`com.ss.android.ugc.aweme`)
3. Restart Douyin

## Disclaimer

- This project is for personal learning and technical exchange only. Please do not use it for
  commercial purposes.
- Any consequences arising from the use of this module are at
  the user's own risk.

## Credits

> In no particular order

- [BiliRoaming](https://github.com/yujincheng08/BiliRoaming)
- [DexKit](https://github.com/LuckyPray/DexKit)
- [gif.kt](https://github.com/shaksternano/gif.kt)
- [Gropify](https://github.com/HighCapable/Gropify)
- [KavaRef](https://github.com/HighCapable/KavaRef)
- [RestoreSplashScreen](https://github.com/GSWXXN/RestoreSplashScreen)
- [YukiHookAPI](https://github.com/HighCapable/YukiHookAPI)
